choices.text: Yoimiya, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Wow, so this is a gift envelope... So pretty! Thank you, it's going straight into my collection!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Seeing you here, getting this gift... Guess it was worth the trip after all!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Huh. Was this not a good enough time for you?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: No no, it's not that! The food is delicious, and there are so many fun things to do. It's just...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: *sigh* I heard, during previous Lantern Rites, there were huge firework shows or tons of Xiao Lanterns.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But, not this time. I thought that huge tree-like lantern might shoot out fireworks at any moment...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Still, Lady Tianquan's ritual was super impressive, and the lights were beautiful.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hehe, at the next festival in Inazuma, I'm gonna put on a giant light show, too!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I'll let you know ahead of time and save you the best seat in the house, so don't miss out!
